request: My office door rubs. Can you replace it with a slab like the others?
contractor_reply: The frame is square. Owner bought a blank slab of the measured size; reuse hinges and knob, fit and paint both faces white. [amount withheld] fixed.

request: Cold air comes in under our front door. We already ordered the replacement.
contractor_reply: It is a prehung unit; verified dimensions, sill sound, same opening. [amount withheld] labor, includes flashing and refitting inside and outside trim. Owner supplies unit and paints.

request: Our upstairs leak left a brown patch on the dining room ceiling. Can you make it disappear?
contractor_reply: Plumber repaired leak, ceiling now dry and firm. Spot-prime then paint the full 12 by 14 ceiling, no drywall replacement. [amount withheld] fixed.

request: Could you patch the holes the electrician left? Our wall has a texture.
contractor_reply: Four openings; match orange peel and prime patches only. Owner paints whole wall. No price yet.

request: The middle plank in my click-floor is gouged. Can you just swap it?
contractor_reply: Matching spare verified. Product unclicks from nearest wall; shift dresser, lift and relay four rows, reinstall baseboard. [amount withheld] complete.

request: Please replace our bedroom carpet with vinyl. I want the door to still swing.
contractor_reply: Measured 120 sq ft. Install owner-supplied LVP on inspected ready floor, remove carpet, haul it and add reducer at hall; swing checked. [amount withheld] labor package.

request: The toilet rocks. Do we need to buy a new one?
contractor_reply: Porcelain intact. [amount withheld] to pull and reset existing toilet with new seal if flange is sound. If flange broken, photograph and quote before separate owner approval. No replacement ordered.

request: Could you put this wider vanity where the little one is?
contractor_reply: New vanity does not clear current shutoffs. Owner hires plumber to move them first. [amount withheld] for install after sign-off, reconnect sink only; owner patches wall.

request: The white seam along my tub is peeling. Can you redo that this week?
contractor_reply: Dry joint, solid tile. Remove and replace caulk only at tub-to-tile seam. [amount withheld]. Tell owner to wait for product's cure time.

request: We bought a TV and want it up over the mantel with no dangling wires.
contractor_reply: Backing verified, bracket supplied. [amount withheld] mount and surface raceway only. They accepted visible paintable cover; no new outlet or in-wall routing.

request: Can you hang three heavy floating shelves on my plaster wall?
contractor_reply: Backing not verified. [amount withheld] site check only, no installation authorized; report options after check.

request: One kitchen cabinet door hangs crooked. Can you make it shut again?
contractor_reply: Cup hole intact; replace two worn matching hinges and align that one door. [amount withheld] all in. Other doors fine.

request: The big pantry drawer sticks halfway. Is it worth replacing the whole thing?
contractor_reply: Box square. Replace pair of side-mount slides at matching length and load rating. [amount withheld] fixed; keep drawer and front.

request: Can you fix the ripped screen the cat got through?
contractor_reply: One frame is straight; rescreen with owner-selected pet mesh and reuse frame. [amount withheld] including mesh.

request: Our double-pane window stays cloudy after cleaning. Can you reseal it?
contractor_reply: I can measure the insulated glass unit for a glazier, not replace glass. [amount withheld] for measurement visit only.

request: Please fix our front lock; my key works with the door open.
contractor_reply: Latch binds only when closed. Hinges and door are firm. Adjust strike and test with existing key. [amount withheld]. No new lock.

request: A corner of the trim by our garage feels soft. Can you patch the bad bit?
contractor_reply: Price [amount withheld] covers one 5-ft exterior trim board, prime and paint. Behind it can't be seen; if sheathing soft, show it and get approval of a separate quote before continuing.

request: Can you put a grab bar in the shower where my mom reaches?
contractor_reply: Owner marked position; backing not confirmed. I will inspect first. No price and no permission to open tile or install until support confirmed.

request: I'd like that giant bathroom mirror removed and saved for my sister.
contractor_reply: Mirror glued; owner changed mind, accepts disposal, not salvage. [amount withheld] includes protection, removal, haul; patch and paint separately by owner.

request: Could you assemble the bunk bed before our guests arrive?
contractor_reply: One supplied kit, all parts checked, room ready. [amount withheld] assembly including manufacturer-specified anchoring; cardboard flattened in owner's garage.

request: My closet doors jump out of their track. Can you make them work?
contractor_reply: Two panels reusable, worn top guide and pivot. [amount withheld] covers replacing both parts, adjustment and testing. No new doors.

request: We have six sets of inside-mount blinds. Can you install them all?
contractor_reply: Five fit. Owner will exchange sixth; [amount withheld] fixed to install five now. Return trip unpriced and unscheduled.

request: Can you smooth the ceiling around the new light? The electrician left it rough.
contractor_reply: Electrician will remove and refit fixture. [amount withheld] patch, sand and prime the surrounding ring only. Owner paints.

request: Can you finish the baseboard after our new flooring went in?
contractor_reply: Measured 38 linear ft. Supply, cut, fit and caulk paint-grade base at [amount withheld] per installed ft; owner paints. No removal needed.

request: Can you fix a cabinet pull, the sticking pantry latch and a loose towel ring in one visit?
contractor_reply: All three accessible, reuse hardware, blocking confirmed. [amount withheld] fixed for the whole visit. No disposal or spare parts needed.

request: The old dishwasher died. Can you install the new one and take the old one?
contractor_reply: Measured opening and connections work. [amount withheld] includes installation, securing, cycle/leak test and haul-away. Owner supplies dishwasher.

request: We never had a dishwasher, but could you put one in the cabinet by the sink?
contractor_reply: Carpentry only. [amount withheld] to modify cabinet opening to chosen model dimensions. Owner arranges electrician, plumber and appliance installer.

request: Can you get our new refrigerator through these narrow doors and hook it up?
contractor_reply: Appliance delivery crew handles carry-in. Existing water line passes fit and shutoff test; I level and connect, check for leaks. [amount withheld]. No old appliance onsite.

request: I ordered a gas range to replace an electric one. Can you connect it?
contractor_reply: No gas at range; no conversion work from me. Owner gets qualified gas contractor and electrician. Do not quote an installation; no charge agreed.

request: Will you fit the induction cooktop where our old one sits?
contractor_reply: Selected model needs a larger stone cutout. Counter fabricator enlarges first, electrician handles electrical connection. [amount withheld] for setting and fastening only after both confirm fit/service.

request: Can you hang the new microwave? We'd like it to vent outside.
contractor_reply: Existing unit recirculates. Owner chose same recirculation for now; verified cabinet, bracket backing and outlet. [amount withheld] includes swap, configure recirculation, testing and haul.

request: We have a hood in a box and want someone to install it for [amount withheld].
contractor_reply: Owner's [amount withheld] is their budget, not my quote. No duct route confirmed. My visit is to inspect fit and options only; visit fee not set.

request: Could you replace our wall oven without touching the cabinets?
contractor_reply: Opening verified too short. Owner will exchange for correct-size model. No install scheduled or priced until new model checked.
